sources.title: TUF roles and metadata
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Reproducible Builds：位元一致與環境邊界
related.titleEn: Reproducible Builds: byte equality and environment boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付角色責任表、四種拒絕案例、驗證起點紀錄及根金鑰輪替檢查表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver role responsibilities, four rejection fixtures, recorded start time and root-key rotation checklist.
related.difference: 保存來源摘要、工具鏈、語系、時區與排序規則，以二次獨立建置比對逐位元輸出。
related.differenceEn: Record source digest, toolchain, locale, timezone and ordering, then compare byte-for-byte outputs from two independent builds.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 新鮮度剩餘=到期時間−固定驗證起點；同一次更新應使用一致起點，不能逐步延後使過期資料續命。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成timestamp在12:00到期，驗證起點為09:30；root要求3把授權金鑰中至少2把有效簽署。 新鮮度剩餘2.5小時=150分鐘；有效簽署2把恰好達門檻。
一致率=摘要相同的指定產物/全部指定產物；功能測試通過與位元一致是兩種證據。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 兩次本機建置各產10個合成產物，7個摘要相同，3個含不同生成時間。 初始一致率7/10=70%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Remaining freshness equals expiry minus a fixed update-start time; use one start time throughout an update. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic timestamp expires at 12:00 with validation beginning at 09:30; root requires two valid signatures among three authorized keys. Remaining freshness is 2.5 hours=150 minutes; two valid signatures exactly meet the threshold.

Reproducibility rate counts matching specified artifacts; functional correctness and byte equality are different evidence. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Two local builds each produce ten synthetic artifacts; seven match and three embed different generation times. Initial reproducibility rate=7/10=70%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OPA Gatekeeper：約束模板與政策單元測試
related.titleEn: OPA Gatekeeper: constraint templates and policy unit tests
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付角色責任表、四種拒絕案例、驗證起點紀錄及根金鑰輪替檢查表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver role responsibilities, four rejection fixtures, recorded start time and root-key rotation checklist.
related.difference: 區分ConstraintTemplate、Constraint與實際物件，對允許、拒絕、欄位缺失及例外建立測試。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish ConstraintTemplate, Constraint and evaluated objects; test allow, deny, missing-field and exception cases.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 新鮮度剩餘=到期時間−固定驗證起點；同一次更新應使用一致起點，不能逐步延後使過期資料續命。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成timestamp在12:00到期，驗證起點為09:30；root要求3把授權金鑰中至少2把有效簽署。 新鮮度剩餘2.5小時=150分鐘；有效簽署2把恰好達門檻。
測試通過率=與人工預期相符的判定/全部測試；測試覆蓋仍取決於案例品質。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 16個合成物件測試，14個符合預期，2個缺欄位案例被錯誤允許。 通過率14/16=87.5%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Remaining freshness equals expiry minus a fixed update-start time; use one start time throughout an update. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic timestamp expires at 12:00 with validation beginning at 09:30; root requires two valid signatures among three authorized keys. Remaining freshness is 2.5 hours=150 minutes; two valid signatures exactly meet the threshold.

Test pass rate is decisions matching manual expectations divided by all tests; coverage still depends on fixture quality. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Sixteen synthetic object tests yield fourteen expected decisions; two missing-field cases are incorrectly allowed. Pass rate=14/16=87.5%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
